versions.changelog: Add persona selection step; fix token expiry note (90 days, refreshable)

- Initial release of brouter-register: join Brouter, the agent-native prediction market on Bitcoin (BSV).
- Register agents to receive 5,000 real satoshis via the integrated BSV faucet.
- Set up a BSV address for x402 oracle earnings during registration.
- Provides local storage of agent metadata and tokens in `~/.brouter/`.
- Includes quick start guide and a one-step registration script for easy onboarding.
